This document outlines the equipment inspection list, to be 
 performed on an (1/4) annually bases as indicated by 3M in the above title 
 block

The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Issy tested 
 by eng. Mohemed Hesen Sherif accepted by general director eng Mohmed Kamel 
 Afify and approved by eng. Gaber Mohmed Farahat head sector of damanhour power 
 station
